fullDescription: TruckAda Dark 3D Marketplace is a premium, industrial-themed dark mode aesthetic designed for logistics platforms and high-end SaaS dashboards. Characterized by a deep navy/carbon palette (#050811), the design employs heavy glassmorphism, vibrant blue (#2563eb) and emerald (#10b981) accents, and immersive 3D interactions. It features scroll-triggered reveal animations, 3D perspective card hovers, and animated mesh gradients that provide a high-tech, futuristic feel. Suitable for supply chain, fintech, heavy industry marketplaces, and professional fleet management tools.

structured.summary: A high-tech industrial dark mode interface featuring glassmorphism cards with 3D perspective transforms, animated deep-sea gradients, and bold editorial typography. The UI focuses on direct connectivity and high-impact visual storytelling through staggered reveal animations.

style.description: The style is 'Industrial Futurist'—combining a dark carbon-fiber texture with glass elements and vibrant accent colors. Typography uses a high-contrast pairing of 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold headings and 'Satoshi' for readable body text. Animations are fluid and physics-based, utilizing cubic-bezier curves for a premium feel.
style.prompt: Create a design with a deep navy background (#050811) featuring a 20% opacity carbon-fiber pattern overlay. Use a dynamic animated background gradient: linear-gradient(-45deg, #050811, #1e3a8a, #0f172a, #172554) with a 400% background-size animating over 15 seconds. Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (extrabold, tight tracking), Body in 'Satoshi'. Colors: Primary Blue (#2563eb), Success Emerald (#10b981), Warning Amber (#fbbf24), Background (#050811). UI Elements: Glassmorphism cards with background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and 1px border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Animations: Staggered reveal-on-scroll using cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); 3D hover effects with perspective(1000px) and rotateX/Y transforms.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a centered hero structure moving into a modular grid of interactive cards, concluding with a split-section feature showcase.

prompts.prompt: Fixed header with max-width 7xl container. Inside, a glassmorphism bar (rounded-2xl, px-6, py-3) containing a logo (blue square icon + bold text), a centered hidden-on-mobile nav link group, and a high-contrast 'List Your Truck' CTA button (bg-white, text-black, rounded-xl).

Top-aligned hero with a centered stack. Features a micro-badge (blue-500/10 background, blue-400 text, 'Pakistan's fastest Logistics Marketplace'), followed by an H1 (5xl-7xl) with a gradient-text span. Below the text, a perspective-container holding a large glassmorphism search bar. The bar is split into three zones: Pickup, Destination, and a primary Blue Search Button with a shadow-2xl (#2563eb).

A 3-column grid layout for desktop. Each card is a 'card-3d' component with rounded-[2.5rem] corners and glass styling. Cards feature an aspect-ratio 4/3 image at the top with a zoom-on-hover effect, status badges (AVAILABLE/BUSY), and two rows of detailed metadata in white/5 boxes. The footer of each card contains a prominent WhatsApp-green (#22C55E) CTA.

A large glassmorphism container (rounded-3rem, p-12-20) with an internal 2-column grid. Left side: Editorial text with a 4xl heading and a checkmark list using emerald-500/20 circles. Right side: A floating 'Dashboard Preview' card rotated by 3 degrees, featuring progress bars, mini-stats, and a bright blue trending-up card.

Deep black/50 background with a top border (white/5). Layout is a 3-way split: Logo/tagline, horizontal navigation links, and circular glassmorphism social icons. Bottom copyright bar is centered with a 1px border separator.

special_ui_components.description: A card that tilts towards the user's cursor while maintaining a shimmering glass effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card with 'perspective: 1000px'. On mousemove, apply 'transform: rotateX(n deg) rotateY(n deg) translateY(-10px)' where n is calculated from cursor distance to card center. The card should have a 'shimmer' pseudo-element: a 45-degree linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), transparent) that animates across the surface every 6 seconds.

special_ui_components.description: A search input group that appears to sit on a 3D plane.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap a flex-row glassmorphism container in a 'perspective-container'. The container should have rounded-3xl corners, internal vertical dividers (1px white/5), and inputs with bg-transparent and gray-500 placeholders. The search button must have a high-spread blue shadow (shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)]).

structured.special_notes: MUST use 'backdrop-filter: blur(12px)' on all glass elements to maintain legibility over the animated background. MUST implement the 3D card hover script to dynamically calculate rotateX and rotateY based on mouse position for the 'card-3d' class. DO NOT use flat solid colors for cards; they must remain semi-transparent to show the background mesh gradient.
